name: Yoco

status.webhook_verification: Svix scheme. Headers 'webhook-id', 'webhook-timestamp', 'webhook-signature'. Strip 'whsec_' prefix, base64-decode the secret, HMAC-SHA256 over '{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{rawBody}', base64-compare; signature header is space-separated 'v1,<b64sig>' entries; reject outside a 3-minute replay window. RAW body required.

credentials_required.label: Secret Key (sk_)
credentials_required.note: server-side auth for all Checkout API calls; sk_test_ vs sk_live_ selects the mode (single host)

credentials_required.label: Webhook Signing Secret (whsec_)
credentials_required.note: returned ONCE when the webhook is registered via POST /api/webhooks; ManishaPay captures and stores it — the merchant does not supply it

test_credentials.note: test keys are instant from the Yoco dashboard (Sell Online -> Payment Gateway -> API keys), no KYC; live keys require KYC

sandbox.notes: Any future expiry, any CVV. ZAR only, card only, minimum charge R2.00 (200 cents).

pain_points.cause: amount sent in Rand instead of cents (Yoco expects minor subunits)
pain_points.mitigation: Single major-unit amount in the ManishaPay API; convert to integer cents internally (× 100) and guard the R2.00 minimum before the call

pain_points.cause: amount below R2.00 (200 cents), Yoco's hard floor
pain_points.mitigation: Enforce a 200-cent minimum locally and return a clear resolution before hitting the API

pain_points.problem: Order marked paid on a spoofed / premature successUrl redirect
pain_points.cause: treating the browser return to successUrl as proof of payment
pain_points.mitigation: Never trust successUrl; confirm on the payment.succeeded webhook or re-fetch GET /checkouts/{id} server-side before fulfilling

pain_points.cause: Svix scheme is easy to get wrong — signing the wrong content, not base64-decoding the whsec_ secret, or hashing a re-serialised body
pain_points.mitigation: One central Svix verifier: strip whsec_, base64-decode the secret, HMAC-SHA256 over '{id}.{timestamp}.{rawBody}' on the RAW bytes, base64 constant-time compare, 3-minute replay window

pain_points.cause: no idempotency applied by default; a network retry re-creates the checkout
pain_points.mitigation: Attach an Idempotency-Key header on every create/refund (derived from the merchant reference)

pain_points.cause: Yoco's online gateway docs are thin and occasionally change endpoints
pain_points.mitigation: Hide Yoco behind the ManishaPay neutral API so integrators never touch the raw surface

pain_points.problem: No native recurring or disputes API
pain_points.cause: Yoco Online is single-charge, card-only; disputes are not exposed programmatically
pain_points.mitigation: Emulate recurring in ManishaPay (stored consent + scheduled charges) or route recurring elsewhere; disputes cannot be auto-mapped, so 'disputed' is never emitted

notes: South Africa only, ZAR only, card only (all 3DS-backed), minimum charge R2.00. No EFT, no recurring, no disputes API. Single host payments.yoco.com — TEST vs LIVE is decided by the sk_test_/sk_live_ key prefix. Webhook secret (whsec_) is issued once on POST /api/webhooks registration and captured by ManishaPay, not supplied by the merchant. Refunds via POST /api/checkouts/{id}/refund (optional partial amount in cents).
